affected.line: Never thought that I could be affected
stanza: Though I saw it all around
Never thought that I could be affected
Thought that we'd be last to go
It is so strange the way things turn
Drove the night toward my home
The place that I was born, on the lakeside
As daylight broke, I saw the earth
The trees had burned down to the ground

disaffected.line: Carcinogenic, diabetic, asthmatic, epileptic, post-traumatic, bipolar and disaf…
disaffected.lineNext: Atomised, thinking we’re engaged when we’re pacified

stanza: I walked into your dream
And now I've forgotten
How to dream my own dream
You are the clever one, aren't you?
Brides in veils for you
We told you all of our secrets
All but one, now don't you even try
The phone has been disconnected

ejected.line: Well in no time we all were ejected
stanza: Well in no time we all were ejected
Soon we were out on the street
The sidewalk began to perspire
We had glass and dog shit at our feet

intersected.line: Made of light from those funny homes, intersected:
stanza: But the sky, over the ocean!
And the ocean, skirting the city!
And the city, bright as a garden
(When the garden woke to meet me)
From that height was a honeycomb
Made of light from those funny homes, intersected:
Each enclosed, anelectric and alone

infected.line: I’ve got a God-shaped hole that’s infected
stanza: I’ve got a God-shaped hole that’s infected
And I’m petrified of being alone now
It's pathetic, I know
